description: Get sync status for connected stores. Pass the sync_event_id returned by rr_trigger_sync to get that request's own receipt (sync_event) and its attempts (sync_event_attempts) alongside recent runs.

connector_type.description: Optional filter for the recent-runs list.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Pass it with the same other inputs until has_more is false.

store_id.description: Optional store UUID filter for the recent-runs list.

sync_event_id.description: Optional sync-event UUID from rr_trigger_sync. Adds that request's receipt and attempt history to the response.

name: rr_get_sync_status
